title: Callvale after: a private bucket and presigned URLs
claim: The browser uploads and plays recordings with short-lived presigned URLs, and the bucket stays private.
alt: After: the browser gets a presigned URL from the application instance and sends recordings straight to the private bucket callvale-audio; a lifecycle rule moves older recordings to S3 Standard-IA.

edges.label: ask for link
edges.say: The browser asks the application for a link to one recording.

edges.label: presigned URL
edges.say: The application signs a presigned URL with its IAM role.

edges.label: upload or play
edges.say: The browser uploads or plays the recording directly in Amazon S3.

edges.label: keeps private
edges.say: Block Public Access keeps the bucket private, and S3 encrypts every new object.

edges.label: lifecycle
edges.say: Versioning keeps earlier versions, and a lifecycle rule moves older recordings to S3 Standard-IA.

notes: Brief 21 story pair, after; 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Decision). Title, claim, alt, steps from brief.json. Same cells as s3-before: browser A1, application B1, recordings B2 in the callvale-audio group (now B2:B3, S3 Standard-IA in B3); Block Public Access takes A3, where the unknown person stood. Step facts are listed in brief.json (diagrams, s3-after). No AWS number, no KMS key, no CloudFront in the drawing.
